description: Read a file's contents at a revision (HEAD by default). Pair it with the working copy to render a real side-by-side or unified diff, rather than parsing a patch.

cwd.description: Repository to run in. Defaults to the workspace root.

rev.description: Revision to read the file at. Defaults to `HEAD`.

content.description: The file's contents at that revision. Empty when the path did not exist there — which is what `exists: false` distinguishes from an empty file.

exists.description: False when the path is absent at that revision (a file being added).
